verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox documents a locations directory where you choose from 2500+ locations. It also supports signing up for multiple mailboxes in different locations to tap different markets, and its addresses are said to meet business registration requirements in most states. The evidence never shows browsing by state and city, and never confirms Delaware or Wyoming specifically, so matching an entity strategy is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit state/city location listing, confirmation of Delaware/Wyoming availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the location-selection experience.

support.subject: As a founder, I can choose the address's state and city to match my entity strategy — Delaware, Wyoming, my home state — from clearly listed locations

citations.quote: Choose from 2500+ locations and get your digital mailbox today!
Yes, you can sign up for multiple virtual mailbox addresses for your business, allowing you to tap different markets or locations.
